approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic landscape billboard mockup for a LinkedIn post. Image 1 is the exact Grand Canyon poster to display; image 2 is the Golden Gate Bridge location photo and base scene. Put the complete poster from image 1 on a realistic freestanding portrait-format roadside billboard beside this bridge, positioned prominently in the foreground off to one side without obscuring the recognizable bridge tower. Preserve the poster's original artwork, colors, border, all lettering and portrait proportions; do not redesign it or add copy. Keep the recognizable bridge, traffic, water, hills, blue sky and daylight appearance from image 2. Extend the surroundings naturally horizontally to make a 16:9 landscape composition. Integrate the billboard with convincing metal supports, perspective, natural lighting and shadows. Make the poster large enough to appreciate in the composition while keeping the bridge clearly visible.
